name: Separable Footprint (SF) Projector
definition: A projector model that accounts for the finite width of detector pixels and volume voxels, providing higher accuracy than methods that do not model finite widths (like Siddon or Joseph), though at higher computational cost.
summary: The Separable Footprint projector is a forward mapping algorithm for X-ray Computed Tomography that calculates line integrals by explicitly modeling finite voxel and detector widths, providing higher quantitative accuracy than Siddon or Joseph methods.
